Hymn 229: Today, While the Sun Shines
Time Signature: 3/4
Musical Key: G Major
Composer: Evan Stephens
Lyricist/Text Author: Lanta Wilson Smith
Category: Special Topics

This is hymn number 229 titled "Today, While the Sun Shines" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in G Major with a 3/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Evan Stephens and the lyrics were written by Lanta Wilson Smith.
This hymn is categorized under: Special Topics.
